objectives.title: Harmonise the heterogeneous 2022-2026 MATE archive and define a physiologically meaningful water-stress target
objectives.measurable_target: QC-controlled common-variable matrix; missingness/measurement-frequency map; target and validation protocol

objectives.title: Develop a parsimonious, interpretable and uncertainty-aware predictive framework under HUN-REN supervision, with ELTE spectral/EO harmonisation, and separate reusable system components from crop-specific biological/calibration parameters
objectives.measurable_target: Ranked predictor set; primary model and nonlinear benchmark where justified; calibration/uncertainty assessment; model card; crop-transfer specification

objectives.title: Prospectively validate the framework at an independent commercial farmer site equipped with project meteorological and soil sensing, supported by physiological, proximal, UAV and Sentinel observations
objectives.measurable_target: Prospective validation dataset; unseen-environment benchmark; spatial scaling assessment; limited-recalibration protocol if required

objectives.title: Operationalise validated outputs in a crop-configurable DrR architecture through continuous Krumatic software development and AgroVIR requirements feedback, followed by industrial evaluation in M25-M30
objectives.measurable_target: Web MVP with validated processing-tomato module; irrigation-attention output; crop-extension specification; AgroVIR requirements/interoperability report; post-MSCA integration and exploitation roadmap

outcomes.title: A physiologically defined water-stress target with a harmonised, QC-controlled five-season evidence base, replacing spectral-proxy stress definitions.
A parsimonious, interpretable, uncertainty-aware predictive framework whose reusable components are explicitly separated from crop-specific parameters, with a documented crop-transfer specification.
Quantified real-world transferability: the transfer gap from research experiments to an independent commercial field measured prospectively, with uncertainty and any limited recalibration stated.

A research-to-operation delivery path: a crop-configurable web MVP carrying the validated tomato module, industrially evaluated by AgroVIR, with a named post-MSCA FMIS-integration and exploitation route and a Bulgarian replication route through MVCRI.

A researcher profile consolidated as an Agricultural Data Scientist specialised in plant stress, Earth observation and decision support, carried by an agreed and reviewed Career Development Plan and the inter-sectoral placement.

HUN-REN ATK acts as recruiting organisation and beneficiary for the fellowship, hosting the fellow at the Agricultural Institute, Martonvásár, with workspace, integration into the hosting group, administrative support, and continuation of arrangements during the M25-M30 placement.
Dr. Roland Hollós (hollos.roland@atk.hun-ren.hu) is the interim project contact until ATK names its administrative or grants-office contact.

Prof. Tibor Janda accepts the primary-supervisor role at HUN-REN ATK, anchoring supervision in the Plant Physiology and Metabolomics Department (which he heads) and carrying the supervision routine of the governance record.

Dr. Roland Hollós participates in FIELDWISE on the ELTE side (associated partner) as the named team member responsible for the predictive-modelling/machine-learning component, retaining the methodological leadership of the modelling workflow (AI/ML approach selection, heterogeneous data integration, model interpretation).
Prof. András Jung accepts the co-supervisor role, carrying the hyperspectral/UAV/EO harmonisation strand as a substantive methodological role.

ELTE continues in FIELDWISE as an associated partner (not beneficiary), providing the remote-sensing/UAV/hyperspectral environment, the co-supervisor, and (from 2026-09-02) the named predictive-modelling/ML team member (see hollos_elte_ml_role).

The fellow conducts or co-conducts UAV and hyperspectral measurements with ELTE's DJI Matrice 350 RTK platform (Zenmuse L1/P1/H20T) and Ultris S5 / Cubert CUVIS cameras, supported by Dr. Zsófia Varga for flight planning, sensor operation and data acquisition, scheduled around key physiological measurement dates at the validation site; ELTE software environments are available for processing.

The M25-M30 placement is conducted mainly through remote collaboration with monthly face-to-face technical meetings for review, feedback and progress assessment. The fellow does not require direct access to AgroVIR's proprietary software, customer databases, office infrastructure or computing equipment; AgroVIR provides the information and data extracts required for interoperability testing in protected form (coded or anonymised field identifiers, e.g. 'Field X'). The fellow works with the AgroVIR product development team responsible for the FMIS platform.
The AgroVIR product development team responsible for the FMIS platform.

No participation in EU-funded research projects. AgroVIR's relevant track record is commercial rather than scientific: twenty years of practice in Hungarian commercial agriculture, and a farm management information system in production use across more than 745,000 hectares in eight countries, including Hungary and Bulgaria — the two countries FIELDWISE works in.

Ownership of placement results follows the grant agreement default, vesting in HUN-REN ATK as the beneficiary acting through the fellow; a written placement agreement between the fellow, HUN-REN ATK and AgroVIR, concluded before the placement begins, will confirm this allocation and the access terms to the fellow's DrR background IP.

Krumatic's prior involvement in deploying the AgroVIR farm-management platform in Bulgaria is a commercial-deployment relationship, stated openly; no ownership, employment or family relationship between Krumatic and the fellow or another partner is known.

The independent commercial farmer provides written field access: site availability for the validation season(s) within M4-M18, permission for sensor installation (automated meteorological station, soil sensors), field measurements and UAV campaigns, agreed irrigation-treatment implementation, and routine crop management responsibilities.

A second independent commercial processing-tomato producer, reachable through the same MATE/ATK professional channel, has been identified and informally approached to serve as first-line backup validation site. If activated and the site meets the measurement protocol, the prospective commercial-field validation claim is preserved; written access is obtained under the same M1 access task as the primary site.

The 2026 resubmission bar ('proposals involving the same recruiting organisation and individual researcher ... must not be resubmitted') is released by changing the recruiting organisation: ATK as recruiting organisation with the same researcher is not barred, and ELTE's continued involvement as an associated partner does not re-trigger the bar, because an associated partner is not a recruiting organisation.
